2607.27267.title: FAVA: Formal Authorization for Verified Agents with Evidence-Backed Permission Graphs
2607.27267.paper_summary: Large language model (LLM) agents autonomously interleave semantic reasoning with complex system operations. In these dynamic environments, static tool-level permissions are fundamentally insufficient; safe authorization is highly context-dependent and heavily reliant on evolving runtime states and data flows. We present FAVA (Formal Authorization for Verified Agents), a permission-carrying authorization framework for agent execution. FAVA utilizes an LLM-guided Permission Intermediate Representation (IR) to translate ambiguous natural-language tasks into structured constraints. A deterministic lowering pass then converts this IR into an evidence-backed permission graph that explicitly tracks data flows, dependencies, and contextual labels. To provide strict security guarantees, a Satisfiability Modulo Theories (SMT) authorizer mathematically verifies the current graph against security policies before any effectful action executes. A runtime gateway then enforces the solver's result, either authorizing the execution or intercepting it with a precise counterexample. We evaluate FAVA across OpenAgentSafety, OctoBench, and ActPlane scenarios. Our evaluation demonstrates that FAVA achieves a 90.5% Decision Compliance Rate (DCR) over the aggregate dataset, successfully intercepting dynamic violating traces in the evaluated trace-conditioned scenarios.
2607.27267.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）代理自主地將語義推理與複雜系統操作交錯進行。<lb/>在這些動態環境中，靜態工具級別的權限基本上是不足的；安全授權高度依賴於上下文，並且在很大程度上依賴於不斷演變的運行時狀態和數據流。<lb/>我們提出了 FAVA（正式授權驗證代理），這是一個用於代理執行的攜帶權限的授權框架。<lb/>FAVA 利用 LLM 指導的權限中介表示（IR）將模糊的自然語言任務轉換為結構化的約束。<lb/>然後，確定性降低過程將此 IR 轉換為一個有證據支持的權限圖，該圖明確跟踪數據流、依賴關係和上下文標籤。<lb/>為了提供嚴格的安全保證，滿足性模塊理論（SMT）授權者在任何有影響的行動執行之前，數學上驗證當前圖形是否符合安全政策。<lb/>運行時網關然後強制執行求解器的結果，無論是授權執行還是用精確的反例攔截它。<lb/>我們在 OpenAgentSafety、OctoBench 和 ActPlane 情境中評估 FAVA。<lb/>我們的評估表明，FAVA 在整體數據集上達到了 90.5% 的決策合規率（DCR），成功攔截了在評估的條件情境中動態違規的痕跡。
